flaming_sword.name: Flaming Sword of Commission
flaming_sword.desc: The blade Michael set in your hands at the Watchtower. It remembers the gate of Eden.

censer_flail.name: Censer-Flail of Raphael
censer_flail.desc: A swinging brazier on a chain, patterned after the censer Aaron ran between the dead and the living. It reaches further than the sword and asks you to bind rather than break.

commission.name: Aspect of Commission
commission.desc: The sword as it was given: balanced, patient, certain.

michael.name: Aspect of Michael
michael.desc: Strikes land like verdicts. Bonus stagger, bonus damage against the iron-armored, and your Ultimate charges faster.

uriel.name: Aspect of Uriel
uriel.desc: The blade remembers the first fire. Attacks burn, dashes leave a flame trail, and your crescent pierces everything it judges.

raphael_aspect.name: Aspect of Raphael
raphael_aspect.desc: The censer as the healer swung it. Your cleanse zones linger far longer, and every enemy you bind knits a little of your own wound shut.

mercy.name: Aspect of Mercy
mercy.desc: Mercy is not weakness; it is patience with teeth. Bound enemies take less damage but pour out far more Revelation when they fall.

dudael.name: Aspect of Dudael
dudael.desc: Named for the place Azazel was bound. Your cleanse zones unmake the desert's corruption pools, leaving safe circles of ash.
